title: Per-role-instance model profiles for the ori (OpenRouter) launch path
description: Committed at .roles/registry/model-profiles.json. The repo pins subagent model TIERS (haiku / sonnet / opus / fable) as policy; this file says which OpenRouter model each tier resolves to when a session is launched through the ori path, per role and per role instance. The ori launcher exports the resolved tiers as ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{HAIKU,SONNET,OPUS,FABLE}_MODEL and the session model as `ori claude --model`, so every subagent in that session follows the same path. Resolution is a deep merge, later wins: defaults <- roles.<role> <- instances.<dir_basename> <- the gitignored .roles/.instance/model-profile.local.json. The vanilla `claude` path never reads this file. Credentials are never here: each session account holds its own OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Authored by architect-cto like charter.md: the review_grade allowlist is policy, the rows are the owner's choices.

model_id.description: An OpenRouter model reference as the Anthropic-compatible endpoint accepts it in the `model` field: `vendor/model`, a dated `vendor/model-YYYYMMDD`, a family alias `~vendor/family-latest`, a router `openrouter/<router>`, or a preset `@preset/<slug>`; an optional `:variant` suffix (floor, nitro, exacto) and an optional `[1m]` context hint (a Claude-Code-side marker, stripped by OpenRouter).

profile.description: One layer of the merge. Every field is optional in a layer; the merged result must have a session and all four tiers.

session.description: The main conversation's model: what `ori claude --model` receives unless an explicit --model is given on the command line.

opus.description: The review class and every other opus dispatch. The merged value MUST be one of review_grade; lint and the launcher both refuse otherwise.

notes.description: Why this layer differs from the one below it — one or two sentences, for the reader of the file.

review_grade.description: The closed set of model references the opus tier may resolve to. Policy, owned by architect-cto: a review's failure mode is a green PR that merges, so the reviewer's model is never a cost decision. Add a router or preset here only after a live test has shown Claude Code forwards that reference verbatim.

defaults.description: The bottom layer. Must be complete on its own: a session and all four tiers.

roles.description: Per-role layer, keyed by the role id as in taxonomy.json.

instances.description: Per-instance layer, keyed by the instance's dir_basename as recorded in .roles/.instance/state.json and registry/bindings.jsonl (e.g. backend-dev-02).
